title: Geology of the Coastal Plain in Ropers Crossroads and North Augusta quadrangles, S.C. Two maps, cross sections and explanation
citation: Willoughby, R.H., 1986, Geology of the Coastal Plain in Ropers Crossroads and North Augusta quadrangles, S.C. Two maps, cross sections and explanation: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-54, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Two OCR map sheets (Part 1 Ropers Crossroads, page 1; Part 2 North Augusta, page 2) on USGS topographic bases. The explanation and cross sections are in an accompanying text that is not in this packet ('For explanation of map symbols see accompanying text'), so no unit descriptions are available. Map faces are mostly noise; only the unit label 'Tuu' is legible (page 2). No references.
SUBSURFACE: base maps state National Geodetic Vertical Datum of 1929 with contour interval 10 feet and 1927 North American Datum (pages 1-2); cross sections named in the catalog title are not in this packet.

map_symbol.note: unit label legible several times on the North Augusta map face; its description is in the accompanying text, not in this packet
